title: North Carolina November 2026 Election Results
text: Democrat Roy Cooper won North Carolina’s November 2026 U.S. Senate race over Republican Michael Whatley by 19.7 percentage points statewide (58.8% to 39.0%), carrying 44 of the state’s 100 counties.
